_README: #5109: a nutrition-coach output that cites only figures the engines serve. The {placeholders} are filled by tests/test_nutrition_coach_context_5109.py from the SAME run: the calorie resolver's target (health.calorie_target.resolve), the protein engine's day total (health.protein_engine.evaluate_day) and the charter's protein floor. The day row is synthetic (round numbers, no owner data). `mutants` are the texts the served-fact gate must flag.
text: You came in at {protein_total_g} g of protein on Sunday, October 18, short of the {protein_floor_g} g floor. Calories sit against the {calorie_target_kcal} kcal target this week. One ask: add a fourth feeding of {feeding_threshold_g} g or more tomorrow.

mutants.stale_protein_target: Your protein target of 190 g is the line to hold this week.
mutants.legacy_per_meal_line: Aim for a 30 g protein threshold at every meal.
